meta.title: Data status
meta.description: Whether Three Marks data collection works: database, collector queue, the Lesta API link and when data was last refreshed.

hint.ok: All services work. Details on the status page
hint.noLestaKey: The Lesta API key is not connected yet: in-game player stats are not collected for now
hint.degraded: Some services respond with a delay
hint.down: One of the services does not respond
hint.unreachable: Could not reach the site server

page.title: Data status
page.lead: See whether data collection works right now and where the numbers on the site come from. The page refreshes itself every minute.
page.componentsLead: Each service is checked on its own.

sources.lesta: Lesta API — player, clan and vehicle statistics. Without an API key these sections honestly show empty states.
sources.mod: The Three Marks mod — battle results of players who run it: damage, marks, economy and loadouts.
sources.replays: Replays uploaded by players — battle breakdowns and replay search.
sources.files: Game files — vehicle characteristics, armour, maps and roles.

notes.noLestaKey: Working without a Lesta API key: collecting mod, replay and game-file data.
notes.stale: Has not reported in a while — data may lag.
notes.closed: Requests to Lesta go through normally.
notes.open: Lesta answers with errors, requests are paused for now.
notes.halfOpen: Trying Lesta again after a failure.
notes.notConfigured: The Lesta API key is not connected yet.

ok.title: All systems go
ok.text: Services are healthy and data refreshes on schedule.

noLestaKey.title: Running without the Lesta API
noLestaKey.text: The Lesta API key is not connected yet. Mod, replay and game-file data keep updating, while the in-game player statistics sections stay empty for now.

degraded.title: Delays
degraded.text: Some services respond slowly — fresh data may arrive later than usual.

down.title: Outage
down.text: One of the services does not respond. Stored data is still available, new data is not coming in yet.

unreachable.title: Server unreachable
unreachable.text: Could not reach the site server. Check your connection or try again in a moment.

unknown.title: Checking
unknown.text: Asking the services for their state.
